title: Steam boiler drum control
goal: A boiler engineer can trace main steam, feedwater, safety relief, and the three-element level-control instruments.

rubric.must: The drum visibly connects to a main-steam line through FT-401E and a feedwater line through FT-402E and LV-401.
LT-401, FT-401, and FT-402 are all visibly shown with loop signals around the feedwater control arrangement.
LIC-401 visibly connects to LV-401 by a pneumatic command line.
LV-401 visibly shows diaphragm actuation and FC fail position.
XV-401 is visibly in series on the main steam path downstream of the steam flow element.
PSV-401 is visibly connected to the drum steam space.
